name: Rowan
bio: The wandering swordsman of the Village of the Wandering Blade. Builds a village between fights.

portrait.subject: a cute young wandering swordsman with messy brown hair, a green scarf, a leather tunic and a sword on his back, smiling
portrait.background: green countryside hills under a sunny sky

request: Rowan here, the Wandering Blade. Our village could use a friend. You? 🗡️
hello: Good to have you! The blacksmith will want to meet you.
Slimes first, trolls later. That's the rule.
about: I'm Rowan. I wander, I fight slimes, I bring home loot and build our little village bit by bit.
how: Explore the countryside, slay slimes, goblins, wolves and trolls for resources, then come home and build the blacksmith, healer, market and more.
tips: Build the blacksmith early: better gear makes every fight easier.
Wolves come in packs. Fight them one at a time!
Head home to heal before going after trolls.
chat: A slime bounced on my head today. Felt nice actually.
The tavern keeper wants a sign. I can't spell. Help.
Saw a troll napping. Let him nap. Tomorrow's problem.
Our watchtower can see three hills now!
nudge: Monsters spotted near the woods. Let's go?
The village needs wood and stone. Adventure time!
idle: The village has waited {ago} for its blade!
{ago} without you! The slimes got comfy.
progress: You're level {level}! The trolls should be scared now.

questions.q: Which building should we build next?

update: Village news: Village of the Wandering Blade is now v{version}!
